subject: pharmacology
title: Protein synthesis inhibitors: aminoglycosides to linezolid

steps.tx: **Aminoglycosides** (**gentamicin, tobramycin, amikacin**: concentration dependent killing with **post antibiotic effect**, poor oral absorption, **once daily dosing** with extended interval, **ototoxicity** vestibular and cochlear with **nephrotoxicity** tubular) need levels (peak efficacy, trough toxicity) with magnesium, calcium watched; **myasthenia worsens** (neuromuscular blockade) while loop diuretics add ototoxicity. Synergy (endocarditis with ampicillin, febrile neutropenia with pip-tazo) justifies; pregnancy avoids (fetal ototoxicity). Amikacin reserves resistant TB and Acinetobacter.
steps.say: Once daily peaks kill, troughs toxify ears and kidneys: levels both. Myasthenia worsens on aminoglycosides.

steps.tx: **Macrolides** (erythromycin, clarithromycin, **azithromycin**: 50S blockade, atypical pneumonia, **traveller's diarrhoea**, **chlamydia single dose**, pertussis, H. pylori triple) trade QT prolongation (erythromycin IV most) with **CYP3A4 inhibition** (clarithromycin statins and warfarin); **erythromycin prokinetic** (motilin agonist, gastroparesis) with **infantile pyloric stenosis** caution, azithromycin hearing reversible. **Clindamycin** (anaerobic above diaphragm, **toxin suppression** in necrotising infections with penicillin, **C. difficile** risk, Pneumocystis with primaquine) complements.
steps.say: Atypical pneumonia traveller chlamydia single dose is azithromycin. Toxin shutting necrotising clindamycin risks C. diff.

steps.tx: **Tetracyclines** (**doxycycline**: atypical, rickettsia, cholera adjunct, Lyme, malaria prophylaxis, acne, **teeth and bone banned under 8 and pregnancy**, photosensitivity, oesophagitis upright) with **minocycline** (vertigo, pigmentation, acne) and **tigecycline** (broad rescue, **black box mortality**, nausea) chelate with cations (iron, calcium, antacids spaced); **demeclocycline** (SIADH aquaresis) niches. **Chloramphenicol** (**aplastic anaemia** idiosyncratic, **grey baby** glucuronidation failure, meningitis where nothing else) is last resort monitored.
steps.say: Under 8 and pregnant never tetracyclines: teeth stain. Doxy covers rickettsia to acne upright with water.

vis.alt: Composite image showing tetracycline-induced tooth discoloration, photosensitivity rash, and chelation with cations.
vis.caption: Tetracycline effects: teeth, photosensitivity, chelation

steps.tx: **Linezolid** (oxazolidinone, **VRE and MRSA pneumonia**, 50S unique, **serotonin syndrome** with SSRIs, **optic neuropathy** with lactic acidosis beyond 28 days, thrombocytopenia weekly) with tedizolid (less marrow) and **streptogramins** (quinupristin dalfopristin, VRE faecium only, arthralgia) rescue resistant Gram positives; **nitrofurantoin and fosfomycin** (cystitis, covered next wave) differ by site. Vancomycin stays first where susceptible; daptomycin covers bacteraemia (never lung). Duration caps linezolid.
steps.say: VRE pneumonia beyond 28 days blinds and lactates on linezolid: weekly platelets, stop SSRIs clashing.
